nodes.name: Asha arrives at the firm's garage
aliases: Asha arrives at the firm's garage
nodes.description: Asha drives into the garage under the firm's building after crossing the river bridges.
evidence: The drive thinned out past the river bridges, and by the time Asha pulled into the garage under the firm's building

nodes.name: Asha enters the building before dawn
aliases: Asha enters the building before dawn
nodes.description: She arrives early enough that it is still dark and the attendant barely acknowledges her.
evidence: it was still dark enough that the attendant only nodded her through without looking up

nodes.name: Asha carries her decision to Whitfield's office
aliases: Asha carries her decision to Whitfield's office
nodes.description: She rides the elevator with her briefcase, mentally holding onto a decision she made earlier in the study.
evidence: She rode the elevator with the briefcase against her thigh and the decision she had made in the study sitting quiet inside it

nodes.name: Asha finds Whitfield already in his office
aliases: Asha finds Whitfield already in his office
nodes.description: In the hallway outside Whitfield's office, she sees that he is already inside and occupied with something else.
evidence: The hallway outside Whitfield's office was lit only by the desk lamps that had been left on overnight, and she could see, through the half-open door, that he was already there, already in his chair, already turning a page on something that was not her.

nodes.name: Asha sets down her briefcase outside the office
aliases: Asha sets down her briefcase outside the office
nodes.description: She places the briefcase on a chair outside Whitfield's door and pauses with her hand on the latch.
evidence: She set the briefcase down on the chair outside his door and stood for a moment with her hand on the latch

nodes.name: Asha prepares to make her decision public
aliases: Asha prepares to make her decision public
nodes.description: She recognizes that speaking to Whitfield will turn her private decision into an official record.
evidence: because what she had decided to say to him would, the moment she said it, stop being a decision and start being a record.

nodes.name: Devin texts Asha to talk
nodes.description: Asha receives a message from Devin at 5:43 a.m. saying they need to talk.
evidence: Then her phone buzzed against her hip, and when she lifted it she saw it was not Whitfield's assistant and not the hospital but Devin, at five forty-three in the morning, the message only three words long: we need to talk.

nodes.name: Asha ignores Devin's message
nodes.description: She rereads the text, turns the phone face down, and does not move away from Whitfield's door.
evidence: Asha read the three words again in the dim hallway, then turned the phone face down against her palm so the screen went dark. She did not step back toward the stairwell.

nodes.name: Asha holds position at Whitfield's door
aliases: Asha holds position at Whitfield's door
nodes.description: She keeps her hand on the latch and lets another phone alert go unanswered.
evidence: She kept her other hand on the latch of Whitfield's door, registering the small cold of the brass under her thumb, and let the buzz that followed, a second alert or the same one repeating, pass without lifti
